stem: Nitrogen and phosphorus are elements in Group 15 of the Periodic Table.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Nitrogen is found in inorganic compounds such as nitrogen oxides ($\text{NO}_x$), nitrates and nitric acid.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Identify **one** natural and **one** man-made occurrence of nitrogen oxides in the atmosphere.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation to describe the role of $\text{NO}_2$ in the direct formation of acid rain.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
Peroxyacetyl nitrate, PAN, is a component of photochemical smog.

Describe how PAN forms from $\text{NO}_2$.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text:
Nitric acid reacts with basic oxides to form nitrates.

Write an equation for the reaction of nitric acid with calcium oxide.

parts.label: (a)(v)
parts.text: Describe what is seen when solid calcium nitrate is heated strongly.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
A common test for nitrates is the reaction with $\text{NaOH}$ and $\text{Al}$. Equation 1 shows the reaction.

equation 1 $$3\text{NO}_3^- + 8\text{Al} + 5\text{OH}^- + 18\text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow 3\text{NH}_3 + 8[\text{Al}(\text{OH})_4]^-$$

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Deduce the oxidation state of nitrogen in $\text{NO}_3^-$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the species that is oxidised in equation 1.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
$\text{NH}_3$ is a basic gas.

Describe how $\text{NH}_3$ is able to act as a base.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Suggest the shape of the $[\text{Al}(\text{OH})_4]^-$ ion.

parts.label: (c)
(c)(i)
parts.text: Construct an equation to represent the third ionisation energy of P.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Complete the graph in Fig. 3.1 to show the third to sixth ionisation energies of P.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Complete Table 3.1 to show the properties of nitrogen and phosphorus in their standard states.

Table 3.1

|  | nitrogen | phosphorus |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| state and appearance of standard state | colourless gas | white solid |
| electrical conductivity |  | poor |
| type of bonding |  |  |
| type of structure | simple |  |

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
A form of solid nitrogen has a lattice structure similar to solid iodine.

Identify the type of lattice structure of solid nitrogen.

parts.label: (f)
parts.stem:
At very high temperatures, phosphorus can form $\text{P}_2$ molecules.

$\text{P}_2$ contains a triple bond, $\text{P}\equiv\text{P}$.

parts.label: (f)(i)
parts.text: Describe the formation of the $\text{P}\equiv\text{P}$ bond in terms of orbital overlap.

parts.label: (f)(ii)
parts.text:
The bond energy of $\text{P}\equiv\text{P}$ is $485\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$. The bond energy of $\text{N}\equiv\text{N}$ is $944\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$.
Compare the reactivity of $\text{P}_2$ and $\text{N}_2$. Explain your answer.
